title: Contextual Fraction on Permutation Gain Graphs: Exact Algorithms, Query Lower Bounds, and Dynamic Maintenance
summary: For an explicitly represented finite empirical model, deciding whether the contextual fraction is strictly below one is NP-complete, while the standard exact linear program has one column for every global assignment. We identify a permutation-transport class in which this global problem collapses to a fixed-point calculation. Let a connected permutation gain graph act on a finite state set $O$, let $H \leq{ \rm Sym}(O)$ be its holonomy subgroup, let $F = {\rm Fix}(H)$, and let $p$ be an $H$-invariant root distribution.
